title: K003: Add comprehensive mock API unit tests
description:
**Size:** 🏗️ large
**Category:** testing
**Priority:** high
**Source:** Proposed for 'With the latest commits/features, E2E tests were added'

Add ~45+ new test functions to test/e2e/mockapi/mockapi_test.go following existing patterns. Per new handler (15 handlers): happy path request returns expected status, counter increments by 1, invalid body returns 400 (for POST/PUT endpoints), wrong HTTP method returns 405. Additional test groups: SSE injection — test that injected event is delivered to a connected SSE client; state configuration — test that POST /test/configure-state replaces fixture and subsequent GET /v1/nodes/{id}/state returns new state; request body capture — test that POST to an endpoint stores body and GET /test/last-request/{endpoint} returns it; concurrent counter atomicity — parallel requests to new endpoints produce correct counter totals.

**Rationale:** New handlers from K001 and K002 add significant logic (method validation, body capture, SSE fan-out, mutex-protected state replacement). Without unit tests, regressions in the mock itself could produce false-positive E2E results. The existing test file establishes clear patterns that should be extended consistently.

**Affected Areas:**
- test/e2e/mockapi/mockapi_test.go

stories.title: Test author verifies all 15 new endpoint handlers return correct status and increment counters
stories.want: each of the 15 new mock API handlers to have a happy-path unit test that verifies the HTTP status code, response content, and counter increment
stories.so_that: regressions in handler logic (wrong status, missing counter, malformed response) are caught before E2E tests run
criteria: Each handler test sends a valid request and asserts the expected HTTP status (204 for fire-and-forget, 200 for endpoints returning data)
Each handler test verifies the dedicated counter incremented by 1 via getAssertions()
Handlers returning JSON (keys/rotate, endpoint, secrets, artifacts) have response body assertions verifying fixture fields
204 handlers are verified to return empty response body

stories.title: Test author verifies POST/PUT handlers reject invalid JSON bodies with 400
stories.want: each handler that accepts a request body to return 400 Bad Request when given invalid JSON
stories.so_that: body validation logic is proven correct and consistent across all handlers
criteria: Each POST/PUT handler has a test sending 'not-json' as body and asserting 400 status
The counter is NOT incremented on invalid body (verified via getAssertions())
The error response body contains {"error": "invalid request body"}

stories.title: Test author verifies all new endpoints reject wrong HTTP methods with 405
stories.want: each new endpoint to return 405 Method Not Allowed when called with the wrong HTTP method
stories.so_that: method validation via the registered fallback handlers is proven correct
criteria: POST endpoints have a test sending GET and asserting 405
PUT endpoints have a test sending POST and asserting 405
GET endpoints have a test sending POST and asserting 405
The counter is NOT incremented on wrong method

stories.title: Test author verifies SSE event injection delivers events to connected clients
stories.want: unit tests proving POST /test/inject-event broadcasts a correctly formatted SignedEnvelope to all connected SSE clients
stories.so_that: the SSE fan-out and injection mechanism is proven correct before E2E tests depend on it
criteria: Test connects an SSE client, injects an event, and reads the injected event from the SSE stream
Injected event is in correct SSE wire format (id:, event:, data: fields)
SignedEnvelope in data has generated event_id, issued_at, nonce, mock signature, and original payload
Multiple connected clients each receive the injected event
Inject with no connected clients returns 200 without error
Invalid JSON body returns 400

stories.title: Test author verifies configurable state replaces the fixture and state endpoint returns new data
stories.want: unit tests proving POST /test/configure-state replaces the active StateResponse and subsequent GET /v1/nodes/{id}/state returns the new state
stories.so_that: the mutable state fixture mechanism is proven correct
criteria: POST /test/configure-state with valid StateResponse JSON returns 200
Subsequent GET /v1/nodes/{id}/state returns the configured state instead of the default
state_count counter still increments after state configuration
Invalid JSON body returns 400 and leaves state unchanged

stories.title: Test author verifies enriched default state fixture includes all new config sections
stories.want: unit tests verifying the default StateResponse includes SigningKeys, BridgeConfig, RelayConfig, UserAccessConfig, IngressConfig, SiteToSiteConfig, sample Data entries, and sample SecretRef
stories.so_that: reconciliation code paths for all features are exercised even without explicit state configuration
criteria: Test verifies SigningKeys with distinct current and previous public key strings
Test verifies BridgeConfig, RelayConfig, UserAccessConfig, IngressConfig, SiteToSiteConfig present with disabled/empty values
Test verifies 2 DataEntry items with distinct keys, content types, and non-empty payloads
Test verifies 1 SecretRef with non-empty key and version >= 1
Test verifies existing peers (2), policies (1 with 2 rules), and metadata still present

stories.title: Test author verifies request body capture stores and retrieves raw bytes
stories.want: unit tests proving POST to an endpoint stores the request body and GET /test/last-request/{endpoint} returns the exact raw bytes
stories.so_that: E2E tests can rely on body capture for payload assertions
criteria: POST to an endpoint, then GET /test/last-request/{endpoint} returns the raw body bytes with status 200
GET /test/last-request/{endpoint} returns 404 when no body has been captured yet
Content-Type of captured body response is application/octet-stream
Body capture does not interfere with normal handler processing (counter still increments, response is correct)

stories.title: Test author verifies concurrent counter atomicity for all 19 endpoint types
stories.want: the extended concurrent counter test to exercise all 19 counter-incrementing endpoints with 100 goroutines each
stories.so_that: atomic counter correctness is verified under concurrent load matching CI conditions
criteria: 100 goroutines per endpoint type across all 19 endpoint types (19 × 100 = 1900 goroutines)
All 19 counters equal exactly 100 after WaitGroup completes
Test passes with go test -race without data races

stories.title: Test author verifies assertion endpoint returns all 19+ counter fields
stories.want: the assertion endpoint to return all counter fields including the 15 new ones plus inject_event_count
stories.so_that: E2E scripts can query any counter by name via jq
criteria: TestAssertions_InitialZero extended to verify all counter fields are 0 on fresh server

implementation_notes:
**Scope:** This feature is test-only — it adds ~45+ new test functions to test/e2e/mockapi/mockapi_test.go. It tests the handlers and infrastructure implemented by K001 (PXD-0042: 15 new endpoint handlers, body capture, expanded counters) and K002 (PXD-0043: SSE injection, configurable state, enriched state fixture). No production code changes.

**Dependencies:** K003 depends on K001 and K002 being implemented first. K001 adds the 15 handlers, counters, body capture, and /test/last-request endpoint. K002 adds SSE fan-out, /test/inject-event, /test/configure-state, enriched default state fixture, and inject_event_count.

**Test Patterns (from existing code):**
- Helper: newTestServer(t) → (*mockapi.Server, *httptest.Server) using httptest
- Helper: getAssertions(t, baseURL) → mockapi.AssertionCounters via GET /test/assertions
- Body constants: const registerBody, heartbeatBody at file top
- Naming: TestEndpoint_Behavior (e.g. TestPing_ReturnsOK, TestRegister_InvalidBody_Returns400)
- Happy path: send request → assert status → decode body → verify fields → verify counter via getAssertions()
- Invalid body: POST/PUT with 'not-json' → assert 400
- Wrong method: send wrong HTTP method → assert 405
- Concurrent: sync.WaitGroup with 100 goroutines per endpoint type
- SSE tests: context.WithTimeout, http.NewRequestWithContext, read buf, parse SSE fields

**New helper needed:** doPut(t, url, body) for PUT request tests since http.Post only does POST.

**Key decisions:**
- Deregister has NO invalid body test because endpoints.go:69 passes nil body
- Secrets and artifact have NO invalid body test because they are GET endpoints
- Body constants use minimal valid JSON matching internal/api types
- MetricBatch/LogBatch/AuditBatch are slice type aliases — body constants wrap items in JSON arrays
- SSE injection tests need careful timing: connect SSE client → wait for initial event → inject → read injected event with timeout

**Risks:**
- SSE timing: tests use short timeouts and buffered reads; may need small sleep to ensure SSE client is registered before injection
- Concurrent test duration: 1900 goroutines is fine for httptest server but verify it completes within default test timeout
- Enriched state fixture changes break TestState_ReturnsFixturePeersAndPolicies assertions for Data/SecretRefs — must update existing test

**Key files:**
- test/e2e/mockapi/mockapi_test.go (only file modified)
- test/e2e/mockapi/mockapi.go (read-only reference for handler behavior)
- internal/api/types.go (read-only reference for request/response types)
- internal/api/envelope.go (read-only reference for SignedEnvelope, EventType constants)
- internal/api/endpoints.go (read-only reference for HTTP methods, paths, nil body patterns)
